saints.name: St. Januarius
saints.title: Bishop and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The bishop of Benevento martyred under Diocletian, whose relic of blood is famously venerated at Naples…
biography: Januarius (Gennaro) was bishop of Benevento and, according to his acts, was arrested during the persecution of Diocletian while visiting imprisoned fellow Christians. After tortures he was beheaded near Pozzuoli about the year 305, together with several companions.

His relics were later translated to Naples, where he is honoured as principal patron. A vial believed to contain his blood, kept in the cathedral, is the object of the celebrated liquefaction observed several times each year — a phenomenon the Church presents for veneration without pronouncing on its nature.
saints.knownFor: His martyrdom and the veneration of his blood-relic at Naples.
